name: @app/shared-types
description: Shared JSON Schemas and generated types for the Real Estate AI app

scripts.generate: npm run generate:ts && npm run generate:zod && npm run generate:py
scripts.generate:py: cd .. && uv run datamodel-codegen --input schemas/schema.json --input-file-type jsonschema --output schemas/generated/models.py --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel
